page: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Epdsv6 server family. It is powered by a Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor featuring 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 3.4 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The processor includes 64 KB of L1D cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of L3 cache. This instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, and includes 1890 GB of local SSD storage with Premium Storage capabilities.

Benchmark data highlights strong multi-core and memory subsystem performance. The E32pds_v6 achieves top-tier results in uncached memory bandwidth, reaching 449.0 GB/sec for read operations and 188.31 GB/sec for write operations. Passmark database operations and memory scores are also in the top tier. Multi-core performance is strong, as evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 66297.85 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 20088.0. However, single-core performance remains average, and large-scale LLM inference tasks show poor performance at 4.65 tokens/sec for prompt processing on a 70B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM-based architecture combined with high memory density and bundled local storage offers a resource-dense configuration for memory-bound workloads without the premium cost of traditional x86 memory-optimized instances. This server is highly suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
